name: Buta no Gotoki Sanzoku ni Torawarete Shojo o Ubawareru Kyonyuu Himekishi & Onna Senshi ~Zettai Chi*po nanka ni Maketari Shinai!!~
original_name: 豚の如き山賊に捕らわれて処女を奪われる巨乳姫騎士＆女戦士 ～絶対チ●ポなんかに負けたりしない!!～
source:
That day a country fell.

The princess knight Henrietta and the female warrior Helga continue to escape while protecting the prince of the destroyed country.
However, the party gets caught by a cowardly trap of a group of bandits.
With the the prince taken as hostage, the two warriors cannot offer any resistance.
Their heart and body begin to fall to the depravity as the bandits vent their lust on them without mercy.

As the princess knight heart falll into darkness by the continuous rapes, in order to make the prince her, she solds her soul to the devil…

[Edited from [url=http://www.dmm.co.jp/en/dc/pcgame/-/detail/=/cid=spal_0072/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
那一天，一个国家陷落了。

公主骑士亨丽埃塔和女战士赫尔加一边保护被毁灭国家的王子一边继续逃亡。
然而，一行人却陷入了一群土匪的懦弱陷阱。
由于王子被扣为人质，两名战士无法进行任何抵抗。
他们的心灵和身体开始堕落，强盗们毫不留情地向他们发泄欲望。

当公主骑士的心因不断的强暴而陷入黑暗时，为了成为王子，她将自己的灵魂出卖给了恶魔……
